Life is full of small surprises. It takes twenty minutes to get to the school gate by bike. Last Wednesday, Owen and Amy went to the school gate. Look it up in the dictionary.
Owen plays table tennis with Amy every Wednesday. Owen learned a lot about music. Owen thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. She writes new words in her notebook.
Amy is interested in drawing. Owen borrowed a book about music from the bookstore. Owen wrote about the day in the diary. A gill helps fish breathe underwater.
Owen hopes to visit Xi'an one day. Owen wants to be a engineer in the future. There are always many people at the school library.
